reel.caption:
₹15,000 a month for 15 years: is it really ₹1 crore?

The 15-15-15 rule says ₹15,000 a month for 15 years at 15% a year grows to about ₹1 crore.
At an illustrative 12% a year, the same SIP grows to about ₹75.7 lakh: roughly ₹25 lakh less on the same ₹27 lakh put in.
Returns are never guaranteed, so a plan built on a lower assumed rate is less likely to fall short.

What rate do you assume when you plan?
Send this to the friend who quotes the 15-15-15 rule.

Sources: monthly SIP future-value formula (instalment at the start of each month), calculated at illustrative 15% and 12% a year; ₹15,000 × 180 months = ₹27 lakh invested.
